pieces.Text: A graeae can use her mystic eye to alter the circumstances of any creature within 30 feet. As a swift action, she can cast her eye on a single creature, causing the target to take a -2 penalty or gain a +2 bonus to one of the following (graeae's choice): AC, ability checks, attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks. A successful DC
Will save negates the effect, which otherwise lasts for 1d6 rounds. This is a mind-affecting gaze effect.
